info.title: SweetProcess Universal API
info.description: Manage procedures, tasks, teammates, and process documentation

post.description: Creates a new invitation in SweetProcess.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

invitations[].description: One or more invitation objects to send to SweetProcess.

invitations[].sendMail.description: Whether SweetProcess should send an email for this invitation row.

invitations[].contentType.description: The target object type for the invitation, for example team.

invitations[].permission.description: The permission level to assign, for example view.

invitations[].objectId.description: The numeric ID of the referenced team or document.

invitations[].toUserId.description: The SweetProcess user API URL that should receive the invitation.

contentType.description: The shared object type, for example team.

fromUser.description: The user who created the invitation.

objectId.description: The numeric ID of the shared target object.

permission.description: The permission granted by the invitation.

sharedItem.description: The shared SweetProcess object referenced by the invitation.

status.description: The invitation status, for example pending.

url.description: The API URL for the invitation.
